blockingFindings.scenario: An operator needs to finalize a ready work item from the normal route entry point.
blockingFindings.impact: The primary task is hard to discover because the named action is hidden behind a generic overflow menu.
blockingFindings.evidence: At /work-items/42 in the ready state at 390x844, routes/work-items/42.html renders only the icon button [aria-label="More actions"]; .menu is hidden and the Finalize control is absent until the menu is expanded.
blockingFindings.governingCriterion: The linked interface contract requires a named primary action to be visible in main content without a generic overflow menu.
blockingFindings.fixBoundary: Expose the named Finalize action in the main content or an explicitly labeled primary-action region while preserving the existing finalization behavior.

blockingFindings.scenario: A keyboard user opens the action menu and tries to read and operate the finalization control.
blockingFindings.impact: Low-vision users cannot reliably read the control, and keyboard users cannot see which control has focus.
blockingFindings.evidence: At /work-items/42, 390x844, menu-open ready state, .finish renders 16px normal-weight #888 text on #fff at computed contrast 3.54:1, below the contract's 4.5:1 normal-text threshold, and button:focus removes the visible focus indicator while tabbing.
blockingFindings.governingCriterion: The linked interface contract requires normal text to meet a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background and requires a visible focus indicator for every keyboard-focusable control.
blockingFindings.fixBoundary: Apply the repository's contrast-compliant control styling and restore a visible focus indicator for the affected controls.

blockingFindings.scenario: An operator scans the work-item summary and heading to understand the page hierarchy.
blockingFindings.impact: Related content uses different alignment edges, weakening the established hierarchy and making the route harder to scan.
blockingFindings.evidence: At /work-items/42, 1440x900, the .content and heading begin at 32px from the panel edge; the .summary box begins at 56px after its 24px margin-left and its text begins at 68px after its 12px padding, so related content does not share the 32px edge.
blockingFindings.governingCriterion: The linked interface contract requires main-panel content to align to the shared content edge and use the spacing scale.
blockingFindings.fixBoundary: Align the summary to the shared content edge and replace the one-off spacing with the applicable spacing token.

blockingFindings.scenario: An operator reaches the primary finalization control and attempts to activate it across input methods.
blockingFindings.impact: The changed control violates the explicit component and token contract, reducing target reachability and causing visual-system drift.
blockingFindings.evidence: At /work-items/42, 1440x900, .finish renders at 32px high with a hard-coded #888 background instead of the required action-primary component, color-action-primary token, and 44px minimum target height.
blockingFindings.governingCriterion: The linked interface contract requires primary controls to use action-primary, color-action-primary, and a minimum target height of 44px.
blockingFindings.fixBoundary: Use the required primary control component and token at the affected finalization boundary, including its 44px minimum target height.
